value: Container is ephemeral: beads Dolt DB is not in git. .beads/issues.jsonl is auto-exported by the pre-commit hook; memories go in .beads/memories.jsonl (see CLAUDE.md). Restore in a fresh clone: bd init --prefix rf --non-interactive, then bd import both files.
Core algorithm choice: own numba Priority-Flood (Barnes 2014) + D8 + Kahn topological-sort accumulation; cross-check vs RichDEM/pysheds. Validate vs NIWA REC2 CATCHAREA.

DEMs come from public s3://nz-elevation COG+STAC (EPSG:2193, NZVD2016). Use dem_8m (new-zealand/new-zealand-contour/dem_8m) for catchment area, 1m LiDAR (bay-of-plenty_2019-2022, waikato_2021, northland_2018-2020) for gradients. Never route flow on DSM.

Network: session env 'river-finder' allows services3.arcgis.com (REC2), gis.gns.cri.nz, overpass-api.de (OSM), data.mfe.govt.nz, catalogue.data.govt.nz, nz-elevation S3. The LINZ Data Service needs an API key and is not allowed.

Verified via REC2: Tuakopai is spelled 'Tuakopae Stream' in REC2 (outlet 175.984,-37.843, 8.5 km2), inside the Mangakarengorengo River catchment (outlet 176.043,-37.806, 108 km2), which joins the Wairoa (mouth 176.093,-37.686, 464 km2). Bboxes in regions/*.toml come from REC2 upstream traces. Names: NZ_River_Names_REC2_V1 FeatureServer (nzsegment, RivName); geometry/topology: REC2_Layers/0 (HydroID, NextDownID, CUM_AREA in m2).

Reference regions: Kaimai Range (Tuakopai -> Mangakarengorengo -> Wairoa) and Tutamoe/Waima plateau, Northland (Waima, Waipoua?, Mangakahia). Hypothesis: hard volcanic caprock plateau + high rainfall + escarpment incision -> creeks. Bboxes must be checked by us (Sean can't).

River chain (from Sean): Tuakopai -> Mangakarengorengo ('Manga Korekere') -> Wairoa. Wairoa and Tuakopai are in online guides; Mangakarengorengo is NOT (known locally as the flood run). It is the key held-out validation case: the tool must flag it as an unlisted candidate.

Built 2026-11-11: river-finder CLI (fetch/route/validate/export/viewer/run). Contour 8 m DEM has flat valley floors between 20 m contours, so flat resolution (Barnes 2014b) is required. River mouths on dune flats are ambiguous; measure named rivers >=500 m inland. Validation: named rivers within 3.2%; >5 km2 within 10%: 70-82% (target 90% not met).

Phases 5-8 done on reference regions (2026-11-11): routing on 5 m LiDAR hybrid; reaches.py segments; scoring.py (run finder, signature, composite, logistic regression). Hold-out: Mangakarengorengo ranks #1/#2 of 47 unlisted Kaimai runs. Hydrology = NIWA Henderson&Collins MAF (MfE rainfall grid blocked). Labels heuristic until Sean gives guide sections.

Sean's preferences: browser viewer first plus a GIS export (GeoPackage + QGIS project). Search scope eventually the whole North Island. Gradient band variable, default 20-80 m/km. Wants a composite overlay, possibly from a simple linear/logistic regression trained on per-point features.
